Advanced settings

On updated speakers, you have five to twelve seconds to continue without saying Hey Adam. Say ?that?s all? or tap the center to finish. Announcements do not open listening.

Always ready on the Pi

Your current Piper speaking voice stays on the Pi for fast replies. Home Assistant control, timers and query handling stay on the Pi too.

If either GPU service fails, both model requests use the Pi during the retry period. The first failed request may wait for its timeout. Local models can be slower or less accurate. Home Assistant and weather still need their usual network connections.

Preview home requests

Try how the model interprets a request using your enabled devices and saved model settings. This preview never controls devices, reads live states, or plays audio. Voice commands continue using the existing command rules.

A preview can take up to 30 seconds per model, or a minute with Pi fallback.
